Kom Ombo and Edfu Temples Tour
Luxor Valley of the kings, Hatshepsut Temple and Colossi of Memnon

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo, Egypt
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo, be ready for your Spiritual Meditation Tour. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Aswan High Dam – Unfinished Obelisk and Philae Temple
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel after enjoying the relish of your breakfast, he will escort you to Cairo domestic airport, fly to Aswan, pick you up from Aswan Airport, transfer to your Nile Cruise to start your Spiritual Meditation Tour, check into your Nile Cruise in Aswan, Aswan is considered the origin Chakra, Khnum well known as the master guide in Aswan, it is well known also as god of creation, taste your unforgettable excursions to the High Dam, head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Lunch on board your Nile Cruise, and have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and Edfu Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast on board, amuse your eyes while Sailing to Kom Ombo it is considered the godly basis at the center of Chakra , pay a visit to the Temple shared by Two Gods Sobek and Horus, Kom Ombo Holding energy of Atlantean, then sail towards Edfu, we are still at the Center of Chakra, head out to visit the Temple of Horus in Edfu, where you will have the chance to have connection with your hidden emotions, sail towards Esna while tasting your lunch on board, and have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Karnak & Luxor Temples
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast on board, sail towards Luxor, Start to embrace the culture of Luxor, visit the greatest highlights of Luxor, Karnak Temple with its inconceivable pillars, it was constructed at the Greco Roman kingdom era, It is considering the largest temple in the world, it consists of 6 Temples, The temples of Karnak including ten edifices, six of which are on the east-west axis, and four on the north-south axis, have the chance to experience the magnificent energies of healing while walking through the seven doors of Sekhmet temple, then move towards Luxor Temple, it is connected to the third chakra, Luxor Temple was established by Amenhotep III, but Ramses II added the front part and completed the Temple, Luxor Temple describing the human body structure combined with the centers of its energy, Luxor Temple located in the middle of Luxor city and was connected to Karnak Temple by avenue of sphinxes at ancient time, Lunch will be served on board your Nile Cruise, and have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Luxor Valley of the kings, Hatshepsut Temple and Colossi of Memnon
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast on board, Disembarkation, today we will explore the west Bank of Luxor, walkthrough Valley of the Kings, head out towards the Temple of queen hatshepsut, visit the magnificent Colossi of Memnon, finally Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to your hotel in Luxor. Overnight in Luxor

itinerary.title: Day at leisure in Luxor.
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, today is your relaxing day, manage to relax at your hotel. Overnight in Luxor

itinerary.title: Tour to Dendara and Abydos Temples
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel in Luxor, he will escort you to Seti I Temple (Known as Abydos Temle), it was constructed by the King Seti I, and completed by Ramses II, The Pharaohs believed that the god of underworld buried at Abydos Temple, Abydos Temple located in Sohag city around 135 km. from Luxor and connected with the heart Chakra, The best paintings for Pharaohs and Gods already on the walls of Osiris Temple at Abydos, then move towards Dendara Temple (The Temple of Hathor), Hathor was the God for Love and joy, Dendara Temple around 60 km. from Luxor, obverse Qena Town, it is matching to the heart chakra, Dendara Temple was constructed at the Roman period, it is considered the one of the latest Temples in Egypt, Dendara Temple decoration was combined with the Roman Emperor and the Egyptian Gods, At the end of your tour transfer back to your hotel in Luxor. Overnight in Luxor

itinerary.title: Fly Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, today is your flight back to Cairo, Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel in Luxor, he will escort you to Luxor airport, fly back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Meditation tour at Pyramids of Giza
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, today you will feast your soul while exploring Pyramids of Giza, Giza considered the front Chakra. Start to visit the Sphinx, unleash your inner and increase your knowledge through meditation at the Sphinx, Then move towards the great Pyramid of Cheops, Entrance inside the great pyramid of Cheops included, enjoy private meditation at the King Chamber of Cheops Pyramid, it is considered the Crown Chakra, continue visiting Chephren and Mykerinus, next stop will be to the Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, short camel ride with an extra fees available on request, Lunch will be served at local restaurant, Shopping available to buy souvenirs to your family and friends, at the end of your tour Ibis Egypt tours will escort you back to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Citadel and Old Cairo Tours
itinerary.description: Tasty Breakfast at your hotel in Cairo, start to embrace Cairo culture by visiting The Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, then drive towards Citadel of Salah El-Dein, visit the Alabaster Mosque of Mohamed Ali, with its alabaster walls from inside and outside, then walk through the Old Coptic Cairo, visit The Hanging Church, Abu Serga Church, your last stop will be to Ben Ezra Synagogue, finally Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.
